title: 10 SKU 暂行补货行动清单（P90-free）
status: provisional; not an instruction list; no quantities

based_on.note: 两份输入在 98e1c664 与工作区逐字节一致；未读取任何后续产物（含 model_race.json）

rule.D1: demand.remaining_3m.forecast_p50 (P50 point forecast, live SO excluded)
rule.D2: demand.remaining_3m.p50 (= D1 + positive live open SO; SO<->forecast overlap unproven, may double count)
rule.supply_A: A_low = available; A_high = available + open production remaining (no PO, no intransit)
rule.supply_B: B_min = available + max(raw PO, production remaining, intransit) (maximum overlap); B_max = available + raw PO + production remaining + intransit (no overlap)

tests.t2: inventory.uom_status is a verified unit basis (false for 10/10: unknown_conditional)
tests.t3: B_max < D1 (short even at the most generous supply bound, on the P50 forecast)
tests.t4: A_low < D2 <= B_max (conclusion flips between on-hand-only and all-arrivals)

assignment: always_replenish <= t3 and t1 and t2
rule.cover_treatment: cover is not counted in supply (V0); it can only add supply, so it cannot turn adequacy into shortage and does not change a shortage class; recorded per row as upside evidence

priority_tier.2: t4 and (dedup-stress B_min - D2 < 10% of D2 or duplicate PO share >= 25% of B_max)
priority_tier.4: no arrival lever; short only when live SO is added (D2)
priority_tier.note: tier orders evidence urgency, not purchase urgency

totals.note: totals are cross-checks of the frozen evidence, not an aggregate demand or supply plan
